description: Audit an x402 endpoint URL for HTTPS, host, query-string and path problems that affect catalogs and payments. Before listing an x402 endpoint in a facilitator catalog. Do not choose this when you need the live 402 challenge verified, which needs a request. Example requests: Audit this x402 endpoint URL. | Is my x402 resource URL well formed for a facilitator? | Check this endpoint for payment-catalog problems.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

endpoint.description: The customer's endpoint.txt, as text. Supported: A URL. The endpoint URL. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_x402_endpoint_audit
title: x402 endpoint audit
